from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import random
import os
import math

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
W, H = 3500, 4950
MARGIN = 200
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR PALETTE — Resolute Warmth (refined)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEEP_NAVY    = (8, 18, 38)
NAVY         = (12, 28, 52)
CYAN         = (28, 171, 226)
BRIGHT_CYAN  = (60, 198, 248)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (115, 202, 240)
PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
ICE          = (215, 240, 255)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
GOLD         = (218, 145, 20)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
MUTED_NAVY   = (25, 45, 72)
DIM_DOT      = (18, 32, 58)
GRID_LINE    = (10, 22, 44)
WARM_LINE    = (235, 228, 218)
SOFT_WHITE   = (242, 238, 232)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * t) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: THE CRISIS  (y: 0 → 2080)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Subtle background grid —
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# — Dot field: each dot represents 1 million children —
# Clear zone around hero text so it reads cleanly
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 750
hero_clear_r = 680  # radius of clear zone around hero text

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        # Distance from hero text center
        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            # Bright dot — out-of-school children
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
            # Fade dots near hero text for readability
            if dist < hero_clear_r:
                fade = max(0.15, (dist / hero_clear_r) ** 1.5)
                color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, color, fade)
                r *= fade
        else:
            # Dim dot
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)
            # Also fade dim dots near hero text
            if dist < hero_clear_r * 0.6:
                fade = max(0.1, (dist / (hero_clear_r * 0.6)) ** 2)
                color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, color, fade)
                r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=color)

# — Top labels —
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))
draw.text((W - MARGIN - 310, 148), "UNICEF  ·  EDUCATION", fill=CYAN, font=f("Jura-Medium.ttf", 22))

# — Section reference marker —
draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — HERO: "250" with refined luminous glow —
hero_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 840)
hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Multi-layer glow (8 layers, very gradual)
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    glow_t = i / 10
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.15 + 0.085 * glow_t)
    offset = i * 2
    draw.text((hx - offset, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + offset, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - offset, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + offset, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Final crisp hero text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# — "MILLION" —
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)
draw.text((mx, 1180), million_text, fill=WHITE, font=million_font)

# — Refined decorative line with diamond —
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y
draw.polygon([(dx, dy - ds), (dx + ds, dy), (dx, dy + ds), (dx - ds, dy)], fill=AMBER)

# — Subtitle —
sub_font = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
sub_text = "children are out of school worldwide"
sx = center_x(sub_text, sub_font, draw)
draw.text((sx, 1510), sub_text, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=sub_font)

# — 70% stat (right-aligned, quiet) —
stat_font = f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
stat_text = "70% cannot read a simple text by age 10"
stw = text_w(stat_text, stat_font, draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)
# Small tick marks on left margin at key positions
for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 1  (y: 1880 → 2150)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: BARRIERS  (y: 2150 → 3520)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Cream background —
draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# — Very subtle horizontal texture lines —
for gy in range(2150, 3520, 130):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=WARM_LINE, width=1)

# — Section header —
draw.text((MARGIN, 2220), "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", fill=CHARCOAL, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 2280), (MARGIN + 310, 2280)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
draw.text((MARGIN, 2300), "02", fill=MED_GRAY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — Five barrier columns (refined proportions) —
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),
    ("Poverty",    ORANGE,     0.86, "Families cannot\nafford fees\nor supplies"),
    ("Gender\nInequality", AMBER, 0.74, "Social norms\nlimit girls'\naccess"),
    ("Disability", DEEP_AMBER, 0.62, "~49% never\nenter a\nclassroom"),
    ("Climate\nChange", TERRA, 0.50, "Extreme weather\ndisrupts\nschooling"),
]

col_w = 480
gap = 58
total_cols = 5 * col_w + 4 * gap
start_x = (W - total_cols) // 2
base_y = 3220
max_col_h = 720

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (subtle, every 28px)
    for sy in range(y_top + 22, base_y, 28):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 8) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 8, sy), (x + col_w - 8, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    # Top edge highlight
    highlight = tuple(min(255, c + 25) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x + 1, y_top), (x + col_w - 1, y_top)], fill=highlight, width=2)

    # Left edge subtle shadow
    shadow = tuple(max(0, c - 20) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x, y_top + 2), (x, base_y)], fill=shadow, width=1)

    # Stat text inside column (near top, white)
    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)
    stat_lines = stat.split('\n')
    for j, sline in enumerate(stat_lines):
        sw = text_w(sline, stat_f, draw)
        sx_pos = x + (col_w - sw) // 2
        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    # Label below column
    label_f = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 25)
    label_lines = label.split('\n')
    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

# — Stat lines below columns —
stat_line_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 21)
draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)
draw.text((start_x, 3432), "~49% of children with disabilities out of school in low-income countries", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 2200), (42, 3480)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 2  (y: 3520 → 3720)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 3520, 3720, CREAM, NAVY, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: UNICEF FOCUS & CTA  (y: 3720 → 4950)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Navy background —
draw.rectangle([(0, 3720), (W, H)], fill=NAVY)

# — Subtle grid —
for gy in range(3720, H, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 3720), (gx, H)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)

# — Section reference —
draw.text((MARGIN, 3765), "03", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — Focus areas (left side) —
draw.text((MARGIN, 3795), "UNICEF EDUCATION FOCUS", fill=CYAN, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 33))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 3845), (MARGIN + 270, 3845)], fill=CYAN, width=2)

focus_areas = [
    "Early childhood development",
    "Inclusive education",
    "Gender equality in education",
    "Education in emergencies",
    "Digital and innovative learning",
    "Adolescent skills development",
]

focus_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
for i, area in enumerate(focus_areas):
    fy = 3885 + i * 44
    draw.ellipse([MARGIN + 4, fy + 9, MARGIN + 13, fy + 18], fill=CYAN)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 26, fy), area, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=focus_f)

# — 190+ stat (right side) —
stat_x = W - MARGIN - 510
draw.text((stat_x, 3795), "190+", fill=AMBER, font=f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 105))
draw.text((stat_x, 3925), "countries with UNICEF", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))
draw.text((stat_x, 3956), "education programmes", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))

# — CTA section —
cta_y = 4180
draw.line([(MARGIN, cta_y), (W - MARGIN, cta_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

cta_title_font = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 48), "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", fill=WHITE, font=cta_title_font)

cta_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 29)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 125), "Investing in education means investing in peace,", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 165), "innovation, and sustainable development.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 220), "Together, we can ensure that no child is left behind.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)

# — SDG 4 reference —
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 298), "SDG 4  ·  Quality Education for All", fill=AMBER, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 24))

# — Bottom attribution —
draw.text((MARGIN, H - 105), "unicef.org/education", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))
right_attr = "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN"
raw = text_w(right_attr, f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20), draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - raw, H - 105), right_attr, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 3770), (42, H - 80)], fill=CYAN, width=1)

# — A few hope dots at bottom (bright dots emerging) —
random.seed(99)
for _ in range(35):
    hx_dot = random.randint(MARGIN, W - MARGIN)
    hy_dot = random.randint(cta_y + 50, H - 130)
    v = random.uniform(0.3, 0.7)
    color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 60 * v), int(185 + 60 * v))
    r = random.uniform(2, 4)
    # Keep away from text areas
    if hx_dot > MARGIN + 800 or hy_dot > cta_y + 300:
        draw.ellipse([hx_dot - r, hy_dot - r, hx_dot + r, hy_dot + r], fill=color)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FRAME & FINISHING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Thin inner frame
fi = 32
frame_c = (22, 42, 68)
draw.rectangle([(fi, fi), (W - fi, H - fi)], outline=frame_c, width=1)

# Refined corner marks (L-shapes, 22px)
cm = 22
ci = fi - 6
for cx, cy, ddx, ddy in [
    (ci, ci, 1, 1), (W - ci, ci, -1, 1),
    (ci, H - ci, 1, -1), (W - ci, H - ci, -1, -1)
]:
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx + cm * ddx, cy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx, cy + cm * ddy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Section transition markers on left margin
for my in [1880, 3520]:
    draw.ellipse([(37, my - 4), (47, my + 4)], fill=AMBER)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import random
import os
import math

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
W, H = 3500, 4950
MARGIN = 200
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR PALETTE — Resolute Warmth (refined)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEEP_NAVY    = (8, 18, 38)
NAVY         = (12, 28, 52)
CYAN         = (28, 171, 226)
BRIGHT_CYAN  = (60, 198, 248)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (115, 202, 240)
PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
ICE          = (215, 240, 255)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
GOLD         = (218, 145, 20)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
MUTED_NAVY   = (25, 45, 72)
DIM_DOT      = (18, 32, 58)
GRID_LINE    = (10, 22, 44)
WARM_LINE    = (235, 228, 218)
SOFT_WHITE   = (242, 238, 232)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * t) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: THE CRISIS  (y: 0 → 2080)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Subtle background grid —
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# — Dot field: each dot represents 1 million children —
# Clear zone around hero text so it reads cleanly
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 750
hero_clear_r = 680  # radius of clear zone around hero text

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        # Distance from hero text center
        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            # Bright dot — out-of-school children
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
            # Fade dots near hero text for readability
            if dist < hero_clear_r:
                fade = max(0.15, (dist / hero_clear_r) ** 1.5)
                color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, color, fade)
                r *= fade
        else:
            # Dim dot
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)
            # Also fade dim dots near hero text
            if dist < hero_clear_r * 0.6:
                fade = max(0.1, (dist / (hero_clear_r * 0.6)) ** 2)
                color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, color, fade)
                r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=color)

# — Top labels —
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))
draw.text((W - MARGIN - 310, 148), "UNICEF  ·  EDUCATION", fill=CYAN, font=f("Jura-Medium.ttf", 22))

# — Section reference marker —
draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — HERO: "250" with refined luminous glow —
hero_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 840)
hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Multi-layer glow (8 layers, very gradual)
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    glow_t = i / 10
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.15 + 0.085 * glow_t)
    offset = i * 2
    draw.text((hx - offset, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + offset, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - offset, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + offset, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx, hy - offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx, hy + offset), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Final crisp hero text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# — "MILLION" —
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)
draw.text((mx, 1180), million_text, fill=WHITE, font=million_font)

# — Refined decorative line with diamond —
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y
draw.polygon([(dx, dy - ds), (dx + ds, dy), (dx, dy + ds), (dx - ds, dy)], fill=AMBER)

# — Subtitle —
sub_font = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
sub_text = "children are out of school worldwide"
sx = center_x(sub_text, sub_font, draw)
draw.text((sx, 1510), sub_text, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=sub_font)

# — 70% stat (right-aligned, quiet) —
stat_font = f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
stat_text = "70% cannot read a simple text by age 10"
stw = text_w(stat_text, stat_font, draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)
# Small tick marks on left margin at key positions
for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 1  (y: 1880 → 2150)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: BARRIERS  (y: 2150 → 3520)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Cream background —
draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# — Very subtle horizontal texture lines —
for gy in range(2150, 3520, 130):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=WARM_LINE, width=1)

# — Section header —
draw.text((MARGIN, 2220), "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", fill=CHARCOAL, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 2280), (MARGIN + 310, 2280)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
draw.text((MARGIN, 2300), "02", fill=MED_GRAY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — Five barrier columns (refined proportions) —
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),
    ("Poverty",    ORANGE,     0.86, "Families cannot\nafford fees\nor supplies"),
    ("Gender\nInequality", AMBER, 0.74, "Social norms\nlimit girls'\naccess"),
    ("Disability", DEEP_AMBER, 0.62, "~49% never\nenter a\nclassroom"),
    ("Climate\nChange", TERRA, 0.50, "Extreme weather\ndisrupts\nschooling"),
]

col_w = 480
gap = 58
total_cols = 5 * col_w + 4 * gap
start_x = (W - total_cols) // 2
base_y = 3220
max_col_h = 720

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (subtle, every 28px)
    for sy in range(y_top + 22, base_y, 28):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 8) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 8, sy), (x + col_w - 8, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    # Top edge highlight
    highlight = tuple(min(255, c + 25) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x + 1, y_top), (x + col_w - 1, y_top)], fill=highlight, width=2)

    # Left edge subtle shadow
    shadow = tuple(max(0, c - 20) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x, y_top + 2), (x, base_y)], fill=shadow, width=1)

    # Stat text inside column (near top, white)
    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)
    stat_lines = stat.split('\n')
    for j, sline in enumerate(stat_lines):
        sw = text_w(sline, stat_f, draw)
        sx_pos = x + (col_w - sw) // 2
        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    # Label below column
    label_f = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 25)
    label_lines = label.split('\n')
    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

# — Stat lines below columns —
stat_line_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 21)
draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)
draw.text((start_x, 3432), "~49% of children with disabilities out of school in low-income countries", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 2200), (42, 3480)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 2  (y: 3520 → 3720)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 3520, 3720, CREAM, NAVY, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: UNICEF FOCUS & CTA  (y: 3720 → 4950)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Navy background —
draw.rectangle([(0, 3720), (W, H)], fill=NAVY)

# — Subtle grid —
for gy in range(3720, H, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 3720), (gx, H)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)

# — Section reference —
draw.text((MARGIN, 3765), "03", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# — Focus areas (left side) —
draw.text((MARGIN, 3795), "UNICEF EDUCATION FOCUS", fill=CYAN, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 33))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 3845), (MARGIN + 270, 3845)], fill=CYAN, width=2)

focus_areas = [
    "Early childhood development",
    "Inclusive education",
    "Gender equality in education",
    "Education in emergencies",
    "Digital and innovative learning",
    "Adolescent skills development",
]

focus_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
for i, area in enumerate(focus_areas):
    fy = 3885 + i * 44
    draw.ellipse([MARGIN + 4, fy + 9, MARGIN + 13, fy + 18], fill=CYAN)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 26, fy), area, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=focus_f)

# — 190+ stat (right side) —
stat_x = W - MARGIN - 510
draw.text((stat_x, 3795), "190+", fill=AMBER, font=f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 105))
draw.text((stat_x, 3925), "countries with UNICEF", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))
draw.text((stat_x, 3956), "education programmes", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))

# — CTA section —
cta_y = 4180
draw.line([(MARGIN, cta_y), (W - MARGIN, cta_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

cta_title_font = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 48), "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", fill=WHITE, font=cta_title_font)

cta_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 29)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 125), "Investing in education means investing in peace,", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 165), "innovation, and sustainable development.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 220), "Together, we can ensure that no child is left behind.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)

# — SDG 4 reference —
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 298), "SDG 4  ·  Quality Education for All", fill=AMBER, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 24))

# — Bottom attribution —
draw.text((MARGIN, H - 105), "unicef.org/education", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))
right_attr = "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN"
raw = text_w(right_attr, f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20), draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - raw, H - 105), right_attr, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))

# — Thin left margin accent —
draw.line([(42, 3770), (42, H - 80)], fill=CYAN, width=1)

# — A few hope dots at bottom (bright dots emerging) —
random.seed(99)
for _ in range(35):
    hx_dot = random.randint(MARGIN, W - MARGIN)
    hy_dot = random.randint(cta_y + 50, H - 130)
    v = random.uniform(0.3, 0.7)
    color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 60 * v), int(185 + 60 * v))
    r = random.uniform(2, 4)
    # Keep away from text areas
    if hx_dot > MARGIN + 800 or hy_dot > cta_y + 300:
        draw.ellipse([hx_dot - r, hy_dot - r, hx_dot + r, hy_dot + r], fill=color)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FRAME & FINISHING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Thin inner frame
fi = 32
frame_c = (22, 42, 68)
draw.rectangle([(fi, fi), (W - fi, H - fi)], outline=frame_c, width=1)

# Refined corner marks (L-shapes, 22px)
cm = 22
ci = fi - 6
for cx, cy, ddx, ddy in [
    (ci, ci, 1, 1), (W - ci, ci, -1, 1),
    (ci, H - ci, 1, -1), (W - ci, H - ci, -1, -1)
]:
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx + cm * ddx, cy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx, cy + cm * ddy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Section transition markers on left margin
for my in [1880, 3520]:
    draw.ellipse([(37, my - 4), (47, my + 4)], fill=AMBER)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG")
print(f"Poster saved to {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {W} x {H}")

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import random
import os
import math

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
W, H = 3500, 4950
MARGIN = 200
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR PALETTE — Resolute Warmth (final)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEEP_NAVY    = (8, 18, 38)
NAVY         = (12, 28, 52)
CYAN         = (28, 171, 226)
BRIGHT_CYAN  = (65, 200, 250)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (115, 202, 240)
PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
MUTED_NAVY   = (25, 45, 72)
GRID_LINE    = (10, 22, 44)
WARM_LINE    = (235, 228, 218)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * max(0, min(1, t))) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: THE CRISIS  (y: 0 → 2080)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Subtle background grid
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Dot field — each dot = 1 million children
# Smooth clear zone around hero text
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 720
hero_clear_inner = 520  # fully clear
hero_clear_outer = 780  # gradual fade

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            base_color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
        else:
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            base_color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)

        # Smooth clear zone: fully transparent inside inner, fade between inner and outer
        if dist < hero_clear_inner:
            continue  # no dots in clear zone
        elif dist < hero_clear_outer:
            fade = ((dist - hero_clear_inner) / (hero_clear_outer - hero_clear_inner)) ** 2
            base_color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, base_color, fade)
            r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=base_color)

# Top labels
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))
draw.text((W - MARGIN - 310, 148), "UNICEF  ·  EDUCATION", fill=CYAN, font=f("Jura-Medium.ttf", 22))

# Section reference
draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# HERO: "250" — refined luminous presence
hero_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 840)
hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Subtle glow: just 5 tight layers for clean luminosity
for i in [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]:
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.25 + 0.07 * i)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Crisp final text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# "MILLION"
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)
draw.text((mx, 1180), million_text, fill=WHITE, font=million_font)

# Decorative line with diamond
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y
draw.polygon([(dx, dy - ds), (dx + ds, dy), (dx, dy + ds), (dx - ds, dy)], fill=AMBER)

# Subtitle
sub_font = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
sub_text = "children are out of school worldwide"
sx = center_x(sub_text, sub_font, draw)
draw.text((sx, 1510), sub_text, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=sub_font)

# 70% stat (right-aligned, quiet)
stat_font = f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
stat_text = "70% cannot read a simple text by age 10"
stw = text_w(stat_text, stat_font, draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# Left margin accent line
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)
# Tick marks at key y-positions
for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 1  (y: 1880 → 2150)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: BARRIERS  (y: 2150 → 3520)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Cream background
draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# Subtle horizontal texture
for gy in range(2150, 3520, 130):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=WARM_LINE, width=1)

# Section header
draw.text((MARGIN, 2220), "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", fill=CHARCOAL, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 2280), (MARGIN + 310, 2280)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
draw.text((MARGIN, 2300), "02", fill=MED_GRAY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# Five barrier columns
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),
    ("Poverty",    ORANGE,     0.86, "Families cannot\nafford fees\nor supplies"),
    ("Gender\nInequality", AMBER, 0.74, "Social norms\nlimit girls'\naccess"),
    ("Disability", DEEP_AMBER, 0.62, "~49% never\nenter a\nclassroom"),
    ("Climate\nChange", TERRA, 0.50, "Extreme weather\ndisrupts\nschooling"),
]

col_w = 480
gap = 58
total_cols = 5 * col_w + 4 * gap
start_x = (W - total_cols) // 2
base_y = 3220
max_col_h = 720

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (every 30px, subtle 6-unit color shift)
    for sy in range(y_top + 24, base_y, 30):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 6) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 10, sy), (x + col_w - 10, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    # Top edge highlight
    highlight = tuple(min(255, c + 25) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x + 1, y_top), (x + col_w - 1, y_top)], fill=highlight, width=2)

    # Left edge shadow
    shadow = tuple(max(0, c - 18) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x, y_top + 2), (x, base_y)], fill=shadow, width=1)

    # Stat text inside column (near top)
    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)
    stat_lines = stat.split('\n')
    for j, sline in enumerate(stat_lines):
        sw = text_w(sline, stat_f, draw)
        sx_pos = x + (col_w - sw) // 2
        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    # Label below column
    label_f = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 25)
    label_lines = label.split('\n')
    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

# Stat lines below columns
stat_line_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 21)
draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)
draw.text((start_x, 3432), "~49% of children with disabilities out of school in low-income countries", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

# Left margin accent
draw.line([(42, 2200), (42, 3480)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 2  (y: 3520 → 3720)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 3520, 3720, CREAM, NAVY, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: UNICEF FOCUS & CTA  (y: 3720 → 4950)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Navy background
draw.rectangle([(0, 3720), (W, H)], fill=NAVY)

# Subtle grid
for gy in range(3720, H, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 3720), (gx, H)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)

# Section reference
draw.text((MARGIN, 3765), "03", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# Focus areas (left)
draw.text((MARGIN, 3795), "UNICEF EDUCATION FOCUS", fill=CYAN, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 33))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 3845), (MARGIN + 270, 3845)], fill=CYAN, width=2)

focus_areas = [
    "Early childhood development",
    "Inclusive education",
    "Gender equality in education",
    "Education in emergencies",
    "Digital and innovative learning",
    "Adolescent skills development",
]

focus_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
for i, area in enumerate(focus_areas):
    fy = 3885 + i * 44
    draw.ellipse([MARGIN + 4, fy + 9, MARGIN + 13, fy + 18], fill=CYAN)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 26, fy), area, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=focus_f)

# 190+ stat (right)
stat_x = W - MARGIN - 510
draw.text((stat_x, 3795), "190+", fill=AMBER, font=f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 105))
draw.text((stat_x, 3925), "countries with UNICEF", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))
draw.text((stat_x, 3956), "education programmes", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))

# CTA section
cta_y = 4180
draw.line([(MARGIN, cta_y), (W - MARGIN, cta_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 48), "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", fill=WHITE,
          font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 52))

cta_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 29)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 125), "Investing in education means investing in peace,", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 165), "innovation, and sustainable development.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 220), "Together, we can ensure that no child is left behind.", fill=PALE_CYAN, font=cta_f)

# SDG 4
draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 298), "SDG 4  ·  Quality Education for All", fill=AMBER, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 24))

# Bottom attribution
draw.text((MARGIN, H - 105), "unicef.org/education", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))
right_attr = "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN"
raw = text_w(right_attr, f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20), draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - raw, H - 105), right_attr, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 20))

# Left margin accent
draw.line([(42, 3770), (42, H - 80)], fill=CYAN, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FRAME & FINISHING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Thin inner frame
fi = 32
frame_c = (22, 42, 68)
draw.rectangle([(fi, fi), (W - fi, H - fi)], outline=frame_c, width=1)

# Corner marks
cm = 22
ci = fi - 6
for cx, cy, ddx, ddy in [
    (ci, ci, 1, 1), (W - ci, ci, -1, 1),
    (ci, H - ci, 1, -1), (W - ci, H - ci, -1, -1)
]:
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx + cm * ddx, cy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx, cy + cm * ddy)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

# Section transition markers on left margin

    draw.ellipse([(37, my - 4), (47, my + 4)], fill=AMBER)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

print(f"Poster saved to {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {W} x {H}")

PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * max(0, min(1, t))) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle background grid
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Dot field — each dot = 1 million children
# Smooth clear zone around hero text
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 720
hero_clear_inner = 520  # fully clear
hero_clear_outer = 780  # gradual fade

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            base_color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
        else:
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            base_color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)

        # Smooth clear zone: fully transparent inside inner, fade between inner and outer
        if dist < hero_clear_inner:
            continue  # no dots in clear zone
        elif dist < hero_clear_outer:
            fade = ((dist - hero_clear_inner) / (hero_clear_outer - hero_clear_inner)) ** 2
            base_color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, base_color, fade)
            r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=base_color)

# Top labels
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))

draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# HERO: "250" — refined luminous presence

hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Subtle glow: just 5 tight layers for clean luminosity
for i in [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]:
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.25 + 0.07 * i)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Crisp final text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# "MILLION"
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)

# Decorative line with diamond
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y

# Subtitle

draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# Left margin accent line
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)

for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# Five barrier columns
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),

base_y = 3220

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (every 30px, subtle 6-unit color shift)
    for sy in range(y_top + 24, base_y, 30):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 6) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 10, sy), (x + col_w - 10, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)

        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import random
import os
import math

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
W, H = 3500, 4950
MARGIN = 200
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR PALETTE — Resolute Warmth (final)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEEP_NAVY    = (8, 18, 38)
NAVY         = (12, 28, 52)
CYAN         = (28, 171, 226)
BRIGHT_CYAN  = (65, 200, 250)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (115, 202, 240)
PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
MUTED_NAVY   = (25, 45, 72)
GRID_LINE    = (10, 22, 44)
WARM_LINE    = (235, 228, 218)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * max(0, min(1, t))) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: THE CRISIS  (y: 0 → 2080)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Subtle background grid
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Dot field — each dot = 1 million children
# Smooth clear zone around hero text
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 720
hero_clear_inner = 520  # fully clear
hero_clear_outer = 780  # gradual fade

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            base_color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
        else:
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            base_color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)

        # Smooth clear zone: fully transparent inside inner, fade between inner and outer
        if dist < hero_clear_inner:
            continue  # no dots in clear zone
        elif dist < hero_clear_outer:
            fade = ((dist - hero_clear_inner) / (hero_clear_outer - hero_clear_inner)) ** 2
            base_color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, base_color, fade)
            r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=base_color)

# Top labels
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))
draw.text((W - MARGIN - 310, 148), "UNICEF  ·  EDUCATION", fill=CYAN, font=f("Jura-Medium.ttf", 22))

# Section reference
draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# HERO: "250" — refined luminous presence
hero_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 840)
hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Subtle glow: just 5 tight layers for clean luminosity
for i in [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]:
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.25 + 0.07 * i)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Crisp final text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# "MILLION"
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)
draw.text((mx, 1180), million_text, fill=WHITE, font=million_font)

# Decorative line with diamond
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y
draw.polygon([(dx, dy - ds), (dx + ds, dy), (dx, dy + ds), (dx - ds, dy)], fill=AMBER)

# Subtitle
sub_font = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
sub_text = "children are out of school worldwide"
sx = center_x(sub_text, sub_font, draw)
draw.text((sx, 1510), sub_text, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=sub_font)

# 70% stat (right-aligned, quiet)
stat_font = f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
stat_text = "70% cannot read a simple text by age 10"
stw = text_w(stat_text, stat_font, draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# Left margin accent line
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)
# Tick marks at key y-positions
for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 1  (y: 1880 → 2150)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: BARRIERS  (y: 2150 → 3520)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Cream background
draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# Subtle horizontal texture
for gy in range(2150, 3520, 130):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=WARM_LINE, width=1)

# Section header
draw.text((MARGIN, 2220), "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", fill=CHARCOAL, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 2280), (MARGIN + 310, 2280)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
draw.text((MARGIN, 2300), "02", fill=MED_GRAY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# Five barrier columns
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),
    ("Poverty",    ORANGE,     0.86, "Families cannot\nafford fees\nor supplies"),
    ("Gender\nInequality", AMBER, 0.74, "Social norms\nlimit girls'\naccess"),
    ("Disability", DEEP_AMBER, 0.62, "~49% never\nenter a\nclassroom"),
    ("Climate\nChange", TERRA, 0.50, "Extreme weather\ndisrupts\nschooling"),
]

col_w = 480
gap = 58
total_cols = 5 * col_w + 4 * gap
start_x = (W - total_cols) // 2
base_y = 3220
max_col_h = 720

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (every 30px, subtle 6-unit color shift)
    for sy in range(y_top + 24, base_y, 30):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 6) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 10, sy), (x + col_w - 10, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    # Top edge highlight
    highlight = tuple(min(255, c + 25) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x + 1, y_top), (x + col_w - 1, y_top)], fill=highlight, width=2)

    # Left edge shadow
    shadow = tuple(max(0, c - 18) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x, y_top + 2), (x, base_y)], fill=shadow, width=1)

    # Stat text inside column (near top)
    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)
    stat_lines = stat.split('\n')
    for j, sline in enumerate(stat_lines):
        sw = text_w(sline, stat_f, draw)
        sx_pos = x + (col_w - sw) // 2
        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    # Label below column
    label_f = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 25)
    label_lines = label.split('\n')
    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

# Stat lines below columns
stat_line_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 21)
draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)
draw.text((start_x, 3432), "~49% of children with disabilities out of school in low-income countries", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

# Left margin accent
draw.line([(42, 2200), (42, 3480)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 2  (y: 3520 → 3720)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 3520, 3720, CREAM, NAVY, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: UNICEF FOCUS & CTA  (y: 3720 → 4950)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Navy background
draw.rectangle([(0, 3720), (W, H)], fill=NAVY)

# Subtle grid
for gy in range(3720, H, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 3720), (gx, H)], fill=(14, 30, 55), width=1)

# Section reference
draw.text((MARGIN, 3765), "03", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# Focus areas (left)
draw.text((MARGIN, 3795), "UNICEF EDUCATION FOCUS", fill=CYAN, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 33))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 3845), (MARGIN + 270, 3845)], fill=CYAN, width=2)

focus_areas = [
    "Early childhood development",
    "Inclusive education",
    "Gender equality in education",
    "Education in emergencies",
    "Digital and innovative learning",
    "Adolescent skills development",
]

focus_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
for i, area in enumerate(focus_areas):
    fy = 3885 + i * 44
    draw.ellipse([MARGIN + 4, fy + 9, MARGIN + 13, fy + 18], fill=CYAN)
    draw.text((MARGIN + 26, fy), area, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=focus_f)

# 190+ stat (right)
stat_x = W - MARGIN - 510
draw.text((stat_x, 3795), "190+", fill=AMBER, font=f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 105))
draw.text((stat_x, 3925), "countries with UNICEF", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))
draw.text((stat_x, 3956), "education programmes", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))

# CTA section
cta_y = 4180
draw.line([(MARGIN, cta_y), (W - MARGIN, cta_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)

draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 48), "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", fill=WHITE,

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import random
import os
import math

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIGURATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
W, H = 3500, 4950
MARGIN = 200
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR PALETTE — Resolute Warmth (final)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DEEP_NAVY    = (8, 18, 38)
NAVY         = (12, 28, 52)
CYAN         = (28, 171, 226)
BRIGHT_CYAN  = (65, 200, 250)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (115, 202, 240)
PALE_CYAN    = (175, 225, 248)
AMBER        = (242, 160, 30)
DEEP_AMBER   = (195, 125, 18)
ORANGE       = (238, 148, 58)
CORAL        = (218, 88, 58)
TERRA        = (178, 90, 50)
CREAM        = (252, 246, 236)
CHARCOAL     = (38, 38, 48)
MED_GRAY     = (110, 112, 125)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
MUTED_NAVY   = (25, 45, 72)
GRID_LINE    = (10, 22, 44)
WARM_LINE    = (235, 228, 218)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def f(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def center_x(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    return (W - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]

def text_w(text, font, draw_obj):
    bbox = draw_obj.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def gradient_band(draw_obj, y1, y2, c1, c2, ease=0.65):
    for y in range(y1, y2):
        t = (y - y1) / max(1, (y2 - y1))
        t = t ** ease
        r = int(c1[0] + (c2[0] - c1[0]) * t)
        g = int(c1[1] + (c2[1] - c1[1]) * t)
        b = int(c1[2] + (c2[2] - c1[2]) * t)
        draw_obj.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b), width=1)

def lerp_color(c1, c2, t):
    return tuple(int(a + (b - a) * max(0, min(1, t))) for a, b in zip(c1, c2))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: THE CRISIS  (y: 0 → 2080)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Subtle background grid
for gy in range(0, 2100, 90):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gx in range(0, W, 90):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, 2100)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Dot field — each dot = 1 million children
# Smooth clear zone around hero text
hero_cx, hero_cy = W // 2, 720
hero_clear_inner = 520  # fully clear
hero_clear_outer = 780  # gradual fade

random.seed(42)
cols, rows = 70, 42
spacing_x = (W - 140) / cols
spacing_y = 2050 / rows
bright_indices = set(random.sample(range(cols * rows), 250))

for row in range(rows):
    for col in range(cols):
        idx = row * cols + col
        x = 70 + col * spacing_x + random.gauss(0, 5)
        y = 50 + row * spacing_y + random.gauss(0, 4)

        dist = math.sqrt((x - hero_cx) ** 2 + (y - hero_cy) ** 2)

        if idx in bright_indices:
            v = random.uniform(0.6, 1.0)
            base_color = (int(28 + 32 * v), int(135 + 63 * v), int(185 + 63 * v))
            r = random.uniform(3, 6)
        else:
            v = random.uniform(0.2, 0.55)
            base_color = (int(14 * v + 4), int(28 * v + 5), int(52 * v + 6))
            r = random.uniform(1.5, 4)

        # Smooth clear zone: fully transparent inside inner, fade between inner and outer
        if dist < hero_clear_inner:
            continue  # no dots in clear zone
        elif dist < hero_clear_outer:
            fade = ((dist - hero_clear_inner) / (hero_clear_outer - hero_clear_inner)) ** 2
            base_color = lerp_color(DEEP_NAVY, base_color, fade)
            r *= fade

        if r > 0.5:
            draw.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=base_color)

# Top labels
draw.text((MARGIN, 148), "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 26))
draw.text((W - MARGIN - 310, 148), "UNICEF  ·  EDUCATION", fill=CYAN, font=f("Jura-Medium.ttf", 22))

# Section reference
draw.text((MARGIN, 192), "01", fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# HERO: "250" — refined luminous presence
hero_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 840)
hero_text = "250"
hx = center_x(hero_text, hero_font, draw)
hy = 310

# Subtle glow: just 5 tight layers for clean luminosity
for i in [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]:
    glow_c = lerp_color(CYAN, DEEP_NAVY, 0.25 + 0.07 * i)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy - i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx - i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)
    draw.text((hx + i, hy + i), hero_text, fill=glow_c, font=hero_font)

# Crisp final text
draw.text((hx, hy), hero_text, fill=CYAN, font=hero_font)

# "MILLION"
million_font = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 210)
million_text = "MILLION"
mx = center_x(million_text, million_font, draw)
draw.text((mx, 1180), million_text, fill=WHITE, font=million_font)

# Decorative line with diamond
line_y = 1460
draw.line([(MARGIN + 80, line_y), (W // 2 - 200, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
draw.line([(W // 2 + 200, line_y), (W - MARGIN - 80, line_y)], fill=AMBER, width=2)
ds = 7
dx, dy = W // 2, line_y
draw.polygon([(dx, dy - ds), (dx + ds, dy), (dx, dy + ds), (dx - ds, dy)], fill=AMBER)

# Subtitle
sub_font = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
sub_text = "children are out of school worldwide"
sx = center_x(sub_text, sub_font, draw)
draw.text((sx, 1510), sub_text, fill=PALE_CYAN, font=sub_font)

# 70% stat (right-aligned, quiet)
stat_font = f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 28)
stat_text = "70% cannot read a simple text by age 10"
stw = text_w(stat_text, stat_font, draw)
draw.text((W - MARGIN - stw, 1610), stat_text, fill=MUTED_NAVY, font=stat_font)

# Left margin accent line
draw.line([(42, 280), (42, 1850)], fill=CYAN, width=1)
# Tick marks at key y-positions
for ty in [370, 1180, 1460]:
    draw.line([(36, ty), (48, ty)], fill=AMBER, width=1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSITION ZONE 1  (y: 1880 → 2150)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
gradient_band(draw, 1880, 2150, DEEP_NAVY, CREAM, ease=0.6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: BARRIERS  (y: 2150 → 3520)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Cream background
draw.rectangle([(0, 2150), (W, 3520)], fill=CREAM)

# Subtle horizontal texture
for gy in range(2150, 3520, 130):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=WARM_LINE, width=1)

# Section header
draw.text((MARGIN, 2220), "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", fill=CHARCOAL, font=f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 38))
draw.line([(MARGIN, 2280), (MARGIN + 310, 2280)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
draw.text((MARGIN, 2300), "02", fill=MED_GRAY, font=f("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 15))

# Five barrier columns
barriers = [
    ("Conflict",   CORAL,      0.96, "Girls 2.5×\nmore likely\nexcluded"),
    ("Poverty",    ORANGE,     0.86, "Families cannot\nafford fees\nor supplies"),
    ("Gender\nInequality", AMBER, 0.74, "Social norms\nlimit girls'\naccess"),
    ("Disability", DEEP_AMBER, 0.62, "~49% never\nenter a\nclassroom"),
    ("Climate\nChange", TERRA, 0.50, "Extreme weather\ndisrupts\nschooling"),
]

col_w = 480
gap = 58
total_cols = 5 * col_w + 4 * gap
start_x = (W - total_cols) // 2
base_y = 3220
max_col_h = 720

for i, (label, color, h_ratio, stat) in enumerate(barriers):
    x = start_x + i * (col_w + gap)
    col_h = int(max_col_h * h_ratio)
    y_top = base_y - col_h

    # Column body
    draw.rectangle([(x, y_top), (x + col_w, base_y)], fill=color)

    # Refined striations (every 30px, subtle 6-unit color shift)
    for sy in range(y_top + 24, base_y, 30):
        stripe_c = tuple(max(0, c - 6) for c in color)
        draw.line([(x + 10, sy), (x + col_w - 10, sy)], fill=stripe_c, width=1)

    # Top edge highlight
    highlight = tuple(min(255, c + 25) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x + 1, y_top), (x + col_w - 1, y_top)], fill=highlight, width=2)

    # Left edge shadow
    shadow = tuple(max(0, c - 18) for c in color)
    draw.line([(x, y_top + 2), (x, base_y)], fill=shadow, width=1)

    # Stat text inside column (near top)
    stat_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 18)
    stat_lines = stat.split('\n')
    for j, sline in enumerate(stat_lines):
        sw = text_w(sline, stat_f, draw)
        sx_pos = x + (col_w - sw) // 2
        draw.text((sx_pos, y_top + 16 + j * 22), sline, fill=WHITE, font=stat_f)

    # Label below column
    label_f = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 25)
    label_lines = label.split('\n')
    for j, line in enumerate(label_lines):
        lw = text_w(line, label_f, draw)
        lx = x + (col_w - lw) // 2
        draw.text((lx, base_y + 16 + j * 30), line, fill=CHARCOAL, font=label_f)

# Stat lines below columns
stat_line_f = f("Jura-Light.ttf", 21)
draw.text((start_x, 3400), "Girls 2.5× more likely to be excluded in crisis settings", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)
draw.text((start_x, 3432), "~49% of children with disabilities out of school in low-income countries", fill=MED_GRAY, font=stat_line_f)

gradient_band(draw, 3520, 3720, CREAM, NAVY, ease=0.6)

focus_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)
for i, area in enumerate(focus_areas):

# 190+ stat (right)

draw.text((stat_x, 3795), "190+", fill=AMBER, font=f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 105))
draw.text((stat_x, 3925), "countries with UNICEF", fill=LIGHT_CYAN, font=f("Jura-Light.ttf", 24))

draw.text((MARGIN, cta_y + 48), "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", fill=WHITE,

cta_f = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 29)
